The current Monthly / Quarterly ranking is a 19 Nov 2026 point-in-time snapshot. It is not a historical backtest and must not be used to claim a win rate or outperforming funds.

Method defined and unit-tested: Save the ranking as it was known on each past date, match each fund to its historical NAV for the exact plan/option, enter after the signal date, and assess 21 / 63 / 126 / 252 trading-session forward returns against Nifty 500 TRI on matching dates.

Missing inputs: older dated M/Q zones and achievements, the corresponding historical disclosed holdings/rankings, historical fund-plan NAVs, and matching Nifty 500 TRI levels. The GitHub ranking run/tests passing does not mean these backtesting inputs exist.

Checks implemented: no future-data leakage, no pre-signal entry, no invented outcomes for missing NAV windows, and exclusion of unavailable historical observations. Signals cover only eligible verified holdings in the scanned universe; not full fund portfolios. Test logic is not a substitute for real historical validation.

* Demand % = demand-zone stocks ÷ verified eligible holdings, not the fund's complete holdings. “Zone Weight %” uses available verified position weights. Quantities and holding changes are provider reports, not confirmed trades. Latest monthly holdings dates vary by fund. This is an offline snapshot; opening the file does not refresh ScanX data.
